trades.headline: Their second quarterback scores them nothing every week
trades.yourSurplus: Tuten is your flex and his role is capped — Rodriguez takes the goal line, Allen takes third downs. You still hold Lloyd and Golden for that slot.
trades.theirHole: Team 13 roster Josh Allen and Lamar Jackson in a one-quarterback league. Behind McCaffrey their backs are Rachaad White at 8.9 and Blake Corum at 9.4, and one of them starts every week.
trades.yourLineup: Lamar replaces Stafford at quarterback, worth about 1.5 a week on current projections. He also ranks QB2 to Allen's QB3, so you are asking for the better of the two.
trades.theirLineup: +2.6. Tuten walks into their RB2 slot over White, and they keep the quarterback they use.
trades.risk: Tuten's role could expand if Rodriguez gets hurt, and you would have sold at the bottom. Against that, Lamar's bye is week 13 while Jacksonville's is week 7 — the week Tuten, the Jaguars defence and Cam Little are all out together.

candidates.note: 31% rostered and free. Bowers is out one to two weeks, Tucker played 94.9% of Raiders snaps last season, and Miami's secondary starts a rookie corner who has never taken a regular-season snap.
13% rostered. The other half of the Bowers target vacuum, and he already has chemistry with Cousins from Minnesota. Cheaper than Tucker if you would rather not use a roster spot on the obvious name.
